user.description:
Enter an access key or host and port.
"Use Media Network to share this library and enable DLNA" must be enabled in Options > Media Network.

data_description.api_key: The access key shown in Options > Media Network.
data_description.name: A memorable name for the server, defaults to the name reported by Media Center.
data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the system hosting your JRiver Media Center.
data_description.port: The Media Network port, 52199 by default.
data_description.ssl: Connect over HTTPS rather than HTTP.

credentials.description: Enter your JRiver Media Center user name and password. These can be found in Options > Media Network > Authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Media Center rejected the stored credentials. Enter the user name and password from Options > Media Network > Authentication.

reconfigure.description: Update where Media Center can be reached.

macs.description:
Select the MAC addresses that should be used for wake on LAN.
Requires the Home Assistant Wake on LAN integration to be enabled.

data.use_wol: Configure the jriver.wake action? (requires at least 1 MAC address)

paths.description: Select the remote views that you want to browse in Home Assistant. These can be found in the "Customize views for JRemote, Gizmo and Panel" configuration in Options > Media Network > Advanced. Upgrade to MC32 to remove the need to provide this information manually.

zones.description: Choose whether to expose zones as separate devices.

select_zones.description: Choose which zones to expose as a device.

select_playback_fields.description: Specify additional library fields to expose as attributes on the playing now sensors.

error.no_zones: Must select at least one zone.
error.no_mac_addresses: Must provide at least one MAC address or disable wake on LAN support.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address, must be 6 pairs of hex digits separated by :

abort.wrong_server: The server at this address is not the one this entry was set up for.

init.description: Tune how often Media Center is polled and how the power controls behave.

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between updates while something is playing. Idle zones are polled three times less often.
data_description.turn_off_behaviour: What media_player.turn_off and remote.turn_off should do. Closing Media Center can hang the process on Linux.
data_description.dsp_presets: Names of the DSP presets to expose as sound modes.
